text: Toolchain management The following information shall be provided by the manufacturer to the Technical Service:
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
text: A description of the models and tools which constitute the toolchain and the method used to trace input data, parameters and output data back to the corresponding toolchain version.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
text: The processes which ensure that the personnel developing, testing and validating the toolchain and its components have appropriate experience, expertise, and training and evidence that these processes are implemented and effective. If there are any activities not directly controlled by the manufacturer, there must be an explanation of measures taken to ensure confidence in the quality and integrity of these activities.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
text: A description of the input parameters, along with any uncertainties in the model parameters, which have been used to validate the models included in the tools and toolchain. The manufacturer shall also provide documentation demonstrating that the data used to validate the models covers the intended scope and functionality of the toolchain.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
text: A description of the overall approach to data management.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
text: A description of the management activities which describe the modifications between toolchain releases, version control and the review processes to ensure those modifications result in a toolchain that is still suitable.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
title: Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: Description and analysis of toolchain and components
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method > Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: All parts of the toolchain, tools and models shall be described by the manufacturer.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method > Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: The vehicle manufacturer shall define the validity domain on which the toolchain will be applicable and how the validity domain has been derived including any AEBS performance influencing factors, parameter ranges, assumptions, limitations and tolerances.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method > Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: The documentation shall include a description of the key performance indicators which will be assessed during validation, such as time to collision, remaining distance or impact speed.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method > Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: The documentation shall include a description of the accuracy requirements for the toolchain and its components, including comparison with physical tests.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method > Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: The documentation of the toolchain shall include assumptions, limitations, uncertainties and the necessary levels of fidelity.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method > Description and analysis of toolchain and components
text: The manufacturer shall provide a description of the toolchain assessment methodology, including the impact of any errors and uncertainties on the results and the subsequent consequences for the compliance of the system with this regulation.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Development of the virtual testing method
text: The manufacturer shall review the information produced in addressing the requirements of paragraph 2.3.6.2. and document any implications for the use of the toolchain.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain
title: Verification
text: Verification
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Verification
text: The toolchain and its components shall be capable of accurately representing the relevant aspects of the physical AEBS that is being modelled.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Verification
text: The manufacturer shall provide documentation on the verification activity of the modelling that implements the AEBS function in the toolchain and its components. This shall include a description of the models, their implementation, how they represent the AEBS function and a description of the activities that have been performed to confirm that the models have been correctly implemented.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Verification
text: The manufacturer shall provide an estimation of the numerical errors affecting the toolchain and its components and analysis that the errors remain sufficiently bounded.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Verification
text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate the effect of variations of the model parameters on the output values and identification of the most critical parameters which will influence the results. This shall also include a robust calibration procedure for these parameters.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain
title: Validation
text: Validation
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The vehicle manufacturer shall describe their overall approach to validation including performance measures and a validation strategy. The validation strategy shall be agreed by the Type Approval Authority or its Technical Service, including physical tests performed to demonstrate that the toolchain is an accurate representation of the physical system. The tests performed shall ensure a statistical comparison between physical and simulation results is possible.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The validation strategy shall be defined by the manufacturer and presented to the Type Approval Authority or its Technical Service for review and agreement.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate how the toolchain achieves the key performance indicators defined in paragraph 2.3.6.3. and accuracy requirements defined in paragraph 2.3.6.4. This shall include justification for the choice of key performance indicators and accuracy requirements, and what the criteria is for satisfying these indicators and requirements.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The manufacturer shall provide the list of validation scenarios. The manufacturer shall provide the parameter descriptions and accuracy requirements that were needed to perform the validation tests.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The manufacturer shall provide documentation describing the validation that was performed to establish the credibility of the toolchain. This shall include information related to the processes that were followed, physical tests that were performed and models and tools that were used.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The manufacturer shall provide documentation that demonstrates how they have characterised the uncertainty in the input data and evaluated the model parameters. The overall uncertainty of the results shall be quantified based on the toolchain structure and from the data and its flow through the toolchain. This uncertainty quantification shall allow estimates of the likely errors and the required safety margins that shall be applied to the results when the toolchain is used for virtual testing.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: At the request of the Type Approval Authority or its Technical Service, in addition to the documentation provided by the vehicle manufacturer, additional confirmatory validation, which shall include physical tests, shall be performed or witnessed. These tests may be relevant to the entire toolchain, specific parts of the toolchain or any of its components.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The number of physical tests shall be defined in agreement between the manufacturer and the Type Approval Authority or its Technical Service. They shall be sufficient to cover the validity domain specified by the vehicle manufacturer.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain > Validation
text: The methodology used to generate physical validation data, such as data recording equipment, data processing, calculation of scalar values shall be documented as part of the validation documentation.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests
text: Activity 2: The use of virtual testing results to conduct testing required for approval process
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain
text: Compliance of the Advanced Emergency Braking System with the performance requirements as defined in paragraphs 5.2.1 to 5.2.2. of this Regulation may be demonstrated by the vehicle manufacturer to the Type Approval Authority or its Technical Service by making use of virtual testing of the dynamic manoeuvres described in the paragraph(s) 6.4. to 6.6. of this Regulation.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain
text: All virtual testing results provided by the manufacturer in applying for an approval in accordance with paragraph 4. of this regulation shall refer to the toolchain evaluated and validated according to paragraph 1. of this annex.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests

heading: Annex 4 Virtual testing of dynamic tests > Activity 1: The development, management, verification and validation of the toolchain
text: For each approval application the manufacturer shall provide a confirmation that the virtual testing: (a) Was conducted using a validated toolchain; (b) Was performed by staff with appropriate competences and skills; (c) Has been performing using by a toolchain that has a unique identifier and sufficient information including scope, regulatory applicability and validation history to ensure that there is traceability and assurance that the toolchain is suitable and fit for purpose; and (d) Has been performed using a toolchain within its scope and in accordance with any restrictions.
doc_title: Virtual testing of dynamic tests
